Iowa county corn and soybeans, 2000 to 2025

USDA NASS county estimates joined to Iowa Environmental Mesonet climate-division weather. Built from the SQL outputs in this repo.

Average production per published year, 2021 to 2025. Counties NASS folded into combined-county rows every year show as missing; hover shows how many of the five years a county has. Draw area outlined in black.
Actual yield against a straight-line trend fit in SQL. Red markers are years 10% or more below trend.

Left: share of published counties 10% or more below trend each year. Right: every county and year against July rain in its climate division. Weather is a division average, so single-county storms do not show.

The draw area is Polk County plus the counties that share a boundary with it in the Census county outlines. Expected 2026 bushels are the 2026 trend yield times the latest published planted acres, scaled by the ten-year harvested-to-planted ratio. They are planning numbers for a trend year, with no weather in them.
